style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel shading, calm colors, bright even light. Pure white background.
avoid_en: 文字、ロゴ、現代の建物や服、大陸風（中国風）の服、裸、血

ototachibana.desc_en: Ototachibana-hime, a young noblewoman of ancient Japan about 20 years old, long straight black hair tied low at the back with a simple wooden comb (kushi) set in her hair, a white Kofun-period kinu robe with a long pale indigo pleated mo skirt and a pale orange sash, a green magatama bead necklace, calm determined face, gentle eyes

yamatotakeru.desc_en: Yamato Takeru, a young prince of ancient Japan about 20 years old, slim and strong, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, a white Kofun-period kinu tunic with a dark red sash, white hakama trousers tied below the knees, a straight iron sword at his waist, no helmet, sharp eyes
